Name: Rest and Recover - NPC Companions
Author: PanKoziolek
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b]Rest and Recover – NPC Companions[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Let the residents of Pelican Town join you during your moments of rest.[/b][/size]

NPC Companions is an optional addon for Rest and Recover.
[/center]


[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Resting no longer has to be a completely solitary activity.

While your farmer is sitting and recovering, nearby villagers may notice them, walk over, and begin a short conversation.

Each supported character has their own dialogue topics, personality, friendship requirements, and possible player responses.

After the conversation ends, the NPC stays nearby for a moment and then returns to their previous position or normal daily schedule.

[b]This is not a follower mod.[/b]

NPCs only approach the player during occasional resting moments.


[size=5][b]Main Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Spontaneous NPC visits[/b] while the player is resting.[/*]
[*][b]90 branching conversations[/b] for 30 Stardew Valley characters.[/*]
[*][b]Three unique conversations[/b] for each supported NPC.[/*]
[*]Conversations unlock at different friendship levels.[/*]
[*][b]Three player responses[/b] with different reactions from the NPC.[/*]
[*]Standard Stardew Valley dialogue windows, portraits, names, and response choices.[/*]
[*]Completed conversations are remembered and do not repeat by default.[/*]
[*]NPCs safely return to their previous location or schedule after the visit.[/*]
[*]Safe approach system for stools, chairs, benches, and one-seat furniture.[/*]
[*]Several ready-made visit frequency modes.[/*]
[*]Full Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/*]
[*]English and Polish translations included.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]How It Works[/b][/size]

When the player begins resting, the addon waits for the configured amount of time.

It then searches for an eligible villager in the same location.

The NPC must:

[list]
[*]be in the same location as the player;[/*]
[*]meet the minimum friendship requirement;[/*]
[*]not be participating in an event or festival;[/*]
[*]have a safe and reachable path toward the player;[/*]
[*]not already be busy with another activity controlled by the addon.[/*]
[/list]
If a suitable NPC is found, they will walk toward the player and stop at a safe distance.

The conversation then begins using the normal Stardew Valley dialogue interface.

After the visit, the NPC returns to their previous position or resumes their normal schedule.

If no safe path is available, the visit is skipped.


[size=5][b]Branching Conversations[/b][/size]

Each supported character has three longer conversations.

The conversations generally unlock at:

[list]
[*][b]2 hearts[/b] – lighter and more casual topics;[/*]
[*][b]5 hearts[/b] – more personal interests, work, or family;[/*]
[*][b]8 hearts[/b] – deeper thoughts, worries, and future plans.[/*]
[/list]
During a conversation, the player can choose between three different responses.

Each response leads to a different reaction from the NPC.

The conversations are designed as small immersive moments connected to resting, rather than a complete replacement for the original dialogue system.

[size=5][b]Visit Frequency Modes[/b][/size]

NPC Companions includes several ready-made frequency profiles:

[list]
[*][b]Sporadic[/b] – rare visits with a longer delay and a maximum of one visit per day.[/*]
[*][b]Balanced[/b] – recommended for normal gameplay.[/*]
[*][b]Frequent[/b] – NPCs approach more often and after a shorter delay.[/*]
[*][b]Quick / Testing[/b] – almost immediate visits intended mainly for testing.[/*]
[*][b]Custom[/b] – manually configure all visit settings.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Frequent and Quick modes may interrupt resting often and can become annoying during normal gameplay.[/b]


[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, you can configure:

[list]
[*]visit frequency profile;[/*]
[*]required resting time;[/*]
[*]visit chance;[/*]
[*]search radius;[/*]
[*]minimum friendship hearts;[/*]
[*]maximum visits per day;[/*]
[*]time between visit checks;[/*]
[*]how long an NPC remains after a conversation;[/*]
[*]safe approach distance;[/*]
[*]long conversations;[/*]
[*]completed conversation repetition;[/*]
[*]whether the same NPC can visit multiple times per day.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Safe Furniture Handling[/b][/size]

NPCs do not walk directly onto the occupied seat.

The addon creates a protected area around the player and the furniture being used.

This prevents NPCs from:

[list]
[*]walking onto stools;[/*]
[*]entering one-seat benches;[/*]
[*]colliding with the seated farmer;[/*]
[*]forcing the player to stand up;[/*]
[*]blocking the occupied furniture tile.[/*]
[/list]
If the NPC cannot find a safe reachable position, the visit will not begin.


[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[b]Required:[/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=TU_WSTAW_LINK_DO_GLOWNEGO_MODA]Rest and Recover 1.4.6 or newer[/url][/*]
[/list]
[b]Optional:[/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] – allows configuration directly inside the game.
Rest and Recover – Sitting Actions – fully compatible, but not required.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Rest and Recover 1.4.6 or newer.[/*]
[*]Download NPC Companions.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded folder into your Stardew Valley Mods directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
The final folder structure should look like:

[code]
Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── RestAndRecover.NPCCompanions/
        ├── manifest.json
        ├── RestAndRecover.NPCCompanions.dll
        ├── assets/
        └── i18n/[/code]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*]Requires SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Requires Rest and Recover 1.4.6 or newer.[/*]
[*]Sitting Actions is compatible but not required.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.[/*]
[*]Does not replace original game files.[/*]
[*]Does not edit the original NPC dialogue data.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Known Limitations[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]NPCs must normally be present in the same location as the player.[/*]
[*]NPCs currently stand near the resting player instead of sitting on the same furniture.[/*]
[*]Visits are disabled during festivals and active events.[/*]
[*]A visit is skipped if no safe route can be found.[/*]
[*]Special characters such as Sandy, Krobus, and the Dwarf can only visit in locations they normally occupy.[/*]
[*]Custom NPCs do not currently have their own unique long conversations.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer support has not yet been fully tested.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Testing Command[/b][/size]

To clear the completed conversation history, enter the following command in the SMAPI console:

[code]
rrnpc_reset_conversations[/code]
This command is intended mainly for testing and allows completed conversations to appear again.


[size=5][b]Uninstallation[/b][/size]

Delete the following folder from your Mods directory:

[code]
RestAndRecover.NPCCompanions[/code]
The addon does not permanently modify the original game files.


[size=5][b]Bug Reports[/b][/size]

When reporting a problem, please include:

[list]
[*]your SMAPI log;[/*]
[*]the NPC involved;[/*]
[*]the location and furniture being used;[/*]
[*]your selected frequency profile;[/*]
[*]whether an event or festival was active;[/*]
[*]a description of what the NPC did before and after the conversation.[/*]
[/list]
[center]
[size=4][b]Take a seat, slow down, and let Pelican Town come to you.[/b][/size]

If you enjoy the addon, consider leaving an endorsement or sharing your feedback.
[/center]
